meaning: Topic marker — X is Y
Subject marker — marks the grammatical subject
Object marker — marks the direct object of a verb
Direction/time marker — indicates destination or time
Location/means marker — where action happens or by what means
Possessive marker — X's Y
And/with — connects nouns or indicates accompaniment
example: ともだちとえいがをみます
exampleTranslation: I watch a movie with a friend.

meaning: Also/too — X also, X too
example: わたしもがくせいです

meaning: Seeking agreement — isn't it?, right?
Assertion — I'm telling you, you know
exampleTranslation: This is delicious, I'm telling you.

meaning: Polite verb ending — affirmative/negative
example: まいにちべんきょうします／しません
exampleTranslation: I study every day / I don't study every day.

meaning: Copula — X is Y / X is not Y (polite)
example: にほんごがすきです／すきではありません
exampleTranslation: I like Japanese / I don't like Japanese.

meaning: Te-form — connects sequential actions
example: おきてはをみがいてがっこうにいきます
exampleTranslation: I wake up, brush my teeth, and go to school.

meaning: Negative plain form — do not / does not
Want to do — expresses desire
exampleTranslation: I want to go to Japan.

meaning: Please do — polite request
Because/from — reason or starting point
example: あめがふるからいえにいます

meaning: Until/to — endpoint in time or place
Than/from — comparison or starting point
example: いぬよりねこがすきです
exampleTranslation: I like cats more than dogs.

meaning: It's better to — gives advice or recommendation
example: はやくねたほうがいい
